name: Docker-Controller-Bot
description: Bot de Telegram: Lleva el control de tus contenedores docker desde un único lugar.

variables.name: TELEGRAM_TOKEN
variables.description: This is the Telegram Token of the bot

variables.name: TELEGRAM_ADMIN
variables.description: This is the Telegram Chat-ID of the admin user

variables.name: TELEGRAM_GROUP (DELETE IF NOT USED)
variables.description: This is the Telegram Chat-ID of the group (DELETE IF NOT USED)

variables.name: CONTAINER_NAME
variables.description: Put here the same name you give to the container

variables.name: TELEGRAM_THREAD (DELETE IF NOT USED)
variables.description: This is the topic id of a supergroup (if it is). (DELETE IF NOT USED)

variables.name: CHECK_UPDATE_EVERY_HOURS
variables.description: Delay time in hours between check updates

variables.name: CHECK_UPDATES
variables.description: Set to 1 if you want to check for updates.

variables.name: BUTTON_COLUMNS
variables.description: Number of button columns in Telegram messages
